title: AnthropicAgentOptions
description: Native Claude Agent SDK options and Captain bridge arguments used by the Anthropic agent runtime.

model.title: Model
model.description: Claude model identifier passed to the Agent SDK.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Adaptive reasoning effort used by supported Claude models.

cwd.title: Working directory
cwd.description: Working directory used by Claude Code tools and settings discovery.

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: System prompt string, string blocks, or custom/preset configuration used for the session.

appendSystemPrompt.title: Append system prompt
appendSystemPrompt.description: Captain bridge text appended to the Agent SDK system prompt.

allowedTools.title: Allowed tools
allowedTools.description: Tool names the Agent SDK may use without being denied by Captain's policy.

disallowedTools.title: Disallowed tools
disallowedTools.description: Tool names explicitly denied by Captain's policy.

additionalDirectories.title: Additional directories
additionalDirectories.description: Directories outside cwd that Claude's tools may access.

maxTurns.title: Maximum turns
maxTurns.description: Maximum number of agent turns before the SDK stops.

maxBudgetUsd.title: Maximum budget
maxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum spend in US dollars before the SDK stops.

permissionMode.title: Permission mode
permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission posture translated from Captain's runtime policy.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Claude Agent SDK filesystem and command sandbox configuration.

resume.title: Resume session
resume.description: Claude session identifier resumed by the Agent SDK.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Structured-output JSON Schema passed to the Agent SDK.

outputSchema.title: Bridge output schema
outputSchema.description: Captain bridge JSON Schema converted into the SDK outputFormat option.

promptText.title: Prompt text
promptText.description: Text sent in a Captain bridge prompt request.

promptAttachments.title: Prompt attachments
promptAttachments.description: File and image attachments sent in a Captain bridge prompt request.

approvalMode.title: Bridge approval mode
approvalMode.description: Whether the bridge asks Captain to broker each caller-tool decision.

x-captain-option.note: Captain selects ask only when a caller-tool approval broker is active.

mcpServers.title: MCP servers
mcpServers.description: Agent SDK MCP server definitions injected for Captain caller tools.

x-captain-option.note: Captain builds an HTTP MCP server entry for the active caller-tool endpoint.

canUseTool.title: Tool permission callback
canUseTool.description: Agent SDK callback used to ask Captain for a tool-use decision.

x-captain-option.note: The TypeScript bridge installs a callback backed by the host protocol.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Claude lifecycle and tool hooks installed for monitoring and caller-tool correlation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's bridge installs monitoring and caller-tool hooks when their endpoints are active.

monitorUrl.title: Monitor URL
monitorUrl.description: Captain bridge URL receiving SDK lifecycle hook events.

x-captain-option.note: Captain derives the monitor endpoint from its local serve configuration.

callerToolUseIDKey.title: Caller tool use ID key
callerToolUseIDKey.description: Reserved metadata key correlating MCP tool calls with SDK hook events.

x-captain-option.note: Captain injects its reserved correlation key when caller tools are enabled.

allowDangerouslySkipPermissions.title: Allow bypass permissions
allowDangerouslySkipPermissions.description: Required Agent SDK acknowledgement before bypassPermissions may be used.

x-captain-option.note: The bridge enables this acknowledgement only for Captain's explicit bypass permission mode.

stderr.title: Standard error handler
stderr.description: Agent SDK callback forwarding child-process diagnostics to Captain.

x-captain-option.note: The bridge owns stderr forwarding over the host protocol.

abortController.title: Abort controller
abortController.description: JavaScript AbortController used to cancel an SDK query.

x-captain-option.note: Captain cancels through its bridge protocol instead of accepting a JavaScript object.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Named SDK agent selected as the main execution agent.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select a named Claude Agent SDK agent.

agents.title: Agent definitions
agents.description: Named subagent definitions made available to Claude.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose inline Claude Agent SDK agent definitions.

continue.title: Continue recent session
continue.description: Whether the SDK continues the most recent conversation in cwd.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes only an explicit session identifier.

toolAliases.title: Tool aliases
toolAliases.description: Alternate display names and descriptions for SDK tools.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not rewrite native Claude tool metadata.

tools.title: Tool set
tools.description: Built-in tool preset or explicit SDK tool-name list.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps allow and deny policies instead of replacing the SDK tool set.

env.title: Environment
env.description: Environment variables supplied to the Claude Code child process.

x-captain-option.note: Captain owns child-process environment construction outside the Agent SDK options payload.

executable.title: Executable runtime
executable.description: JavaScript runtime used to launch the Agent SDK child process.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's packaged bridge owns the executable runtime.

executableArgs.title: Executable arguments
executableArgs.description: Arguments prepended when launching the Agent SDK runtime.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose bridge runtime arguments.

extraArgs.title: Extra Claude arguments
extraArgs.description: Additional raw command-line arguments passed by the SDK to Claude Code.

x-captain-option.note: Captain exposes typed request fields rather than raw Claude arguments.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model used if the requested Claude model is unavailable.

x-captain-option.note: Captain performs fallback selection in its provider registry.

enableFileCheckpointing.title: File checkpointing
enableFileCheckpointing.description: Whether the SDK records file state so edits can be rewound.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose SDK file checkpointing.

toolConfig.title: Tool configuration
toolConfig.description: Native per-tool configuration supplied to the Agent SDK.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Agent SDK per-tool configuration.

forkSession.title: Fork session
forkSession.description: Whether resuming creates a new session identifier instead of continuing in place.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes the requested session in place.

betas.title: Beta features
betas.description: Anthropic beta feature identifiers enabled for the SDK query.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose per-query Anthropic beta headers.

onElicitation.title: Elicitation callback
onElicitation.description: Callback handling MCP elicitation requests from the SDK.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's bridge does not provide an MCP elicitation callback.

onUserDialog.title: User dialog callback
onUserDialog.description: Callback handling native Claude user-dialog requests.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not bridge native Agent SDK user dialogs.

supportedDialogKinds.title: Supported dialog kinds
supportedDialogKinds.description: User-dialog kinds the host declares it can render.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not advertise Agent SDK native dialog rendering.

persistSession.title: Persist session
persistSession.description: Whether the Agent SDK persists the session to disk.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override the Agent SDK persistence default.

sessionStore.title: Session store
sessionStore.description: Custom storage implementation used for Agent SDK session data.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not inject a custom Agent SDK session store.

sessionStoreFlush.title: Session store flush
sessionStoreFlush.description: Callback invoked to flush custom session storage.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not inject a custom session store flush callback.

loadTimeoutMs.title: Load timeout
loadTimeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed when loading a persisted session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override the SDK session-load timeout.

includeHookEvents.title: Include hook events
includeHookEvents.description: Whether hook lifecycle events are emitted in the SDK message stream.

x-captain-option.note: Captain receives its installed hooks directly instead of emitting hook messages.

includePartialMessages.title: Include partial messages
includePartialMessages.description: Whether partial assistant message chunks are emitted by the SDK.

x-captain-option.note: Captain consumes complete SDK message events.

forwardSubagentText.title: Forward subagent text
forwardSubagentText.description: Whether subagent text is forwarded into the parent query stream.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not enable native SDK subagent text forwarding.

thinking.title: Thinking
thinking.description: Detailed native thinking configuration beyond the effort level.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps model.effort and does not expose the lower-level SDK thinking object.

maxThinkingTokens.title: Maximum thinking tokens
maxThinkingTokens.description: Maximum tokens allocated to extended thinking.

x-captain-option.note: Captain exposes effort rather than a fixed thinking-token budget.

taskBudget.title: Task budget
taskBudget.description: Native budget constraints applied to SDK task execution.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps maxTurns and maxBudgetUsd but not the SDK taskBudget object.

pathToClaudeCodeExecutable.title: Claude executable path
pathToClaudeCodeExecutable.description: Filesystem path to the Claude Code executable launched by the SDK.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's package resolver owns the Claude Code executable path.

permissionPromptToolName.title: Permission prompt tool
permissionPromptToolName.description: MCP tool name used by Claude Code to request permission decisions.

x-captain-option.note: Captain uses the Agent SDK canUseTool callback instead of a permission-prompt MCP tool.

planModeInstructions.title: Plan mode instructions
planModeInstructions.description: Additional instructions injected when Claude enters plan mode.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not override Claude's native plan-mode instructions.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Local Claude Code plugin directories loaded for the query.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Agent SDK plugin loading.

promptSuggestions.title: Prompt suggestions
promptSuggestions.description: Whether the SDK emits suggested follow-up prompts.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not request Agent SDK prompt suggestions.

agentProgressSummaries.title: Agent progress summaries
agentProgressSummaries.description: Whether progress summaries are generated for long-running agent work.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not enable native SDK progress summaries.

sessionId.title: New session ID
sessionId.description: Explicit UUID assigned when starting a new Agent SDK session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain reads the session identifier emitted by the SDK instead of assigning one.

resumeSessionAt.title: Resume session at
resumeSessionAt.description: Message identifier at which an existing session is resumed.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes the latest point of an explicit session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: In-memory Claude Code settings applied to the query.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not inject Agent SDK settings objects.

managedSettings.title: Managed settings
managedSettings.description: Enterprise-managed Claude Code settings applied to the query.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not inject enterprise-managed settings.

settingSources.title: Setting sources
settingSources.description: Filesystem setting scopes loaded by Claude Code.

x-captain-option.note: Captain leaves Agent SDK settings-source discovery at its default.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skill configuration made available to the Agent SDK query.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not pass inline Agent SDK skill configuration.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Whether Agent SDK debug logging is enabled.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose the SDK debug switch.

debugFile.title: Debug file
debugFile.description: Path receiving Agent SDK debug logs.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose native SDK debug-file output.

strictMcpConfig.title: Strict MCP configuration
strictMcpConfig.description: Whether Claude ignores all MCP servers except those supplied in options.

x-captain-option.note: Captain injects its caller-tool server without replacing user MCP configuration.

title.title: Session title
title.description: Display title assigned to the Claude Agent SDK session.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not assign an SDK-native session title.

spawnClaudeCodeProcess.title: Process spawner
spawnClaudeCodeProcess.description: Custom callback used by the SDK to start the Claude Code process.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's packaged bridge uses the SDK default process spawner.

projectConfigRoot.title: Project config root
projectConfigRoot.description: Trusted checkout that cwd is a worktree of; project settings, .mcp.json and .claude config trees load from here instead of cwd.

x-captain-option.note: Captain loads project configuration from the run's working directory.

perTaskStopAffordance.title: Per-task stop affordance
perTaskStopAffordance.description: Declares that the host can stop individual background tasks, so an interrupt only aborts the current turn.

x-captain-option.note: Captain interrupts stop the whole query, including background tasks.

verbatimPrompts.title: Verbatim prompts
verbatimPrompts.description: Deliver prompt text as written, without @path expansion, slash-command dispatch or turn-start attachments.

x-captain-option.note: Captain sends prompts with the SDK default mention and slash-command handling.

permissionPrompts.title: Permission prompts
permissionPrompts.description: Who answers permission prompts: the host through canUseTool, or nobody so prompting requests are denied.

x-captain-option.note: Captain always answers permission prompts through its canUseTool callback.

pluginDelivery.title: Plugin delivery
pluginDelivery.description: How plugins reach the Claude Code process: --plugin-dir arguments or the initialize request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Agent SDK plugin loading.

resumeDropsTurn.title: Resume drops turn
resumeDropsTurn.description: Guarded fork point paired with resumeSessionAt that discards the turn after the kept chain entry.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes the latest point of an explicit session.
